surfaces.condition: A material feature, functionality, behavior, CLI/API, workflow, data, integration, security/privacy, or quality/release change is added or changed.
validation: Update this matrix in the same change with affected surfaces, contracts, documentation, tests, evidence, owners, and projections.
For a purely internal refactor or isolated fix with no matrix impact, record a reviewed no-impact reason in the same change record; omission is not an implicit no-impact decision.

surfaces.condition: Repository evidence, persistence, routing, provider, quality, remediation, or command contracts change.
validation: pnpm cli route --fresh --json against the imported full fleet detector corpus
For maturity changes, verify pillar weighting, applicability, evidence coverage, and critical caps in src-tauri/src/quality.rs tests.
Run the parallel refresh coordinator tests and verify the locked merge preserves every scanned repository.

surfaces.condition: A projected field, state label, navigation surface, or user-visible remediation behavior changes.
validation: Verify the Dock Refresh action invokes refresh_batch and renders the returned merged snapshot.

surfaces.condition: Analytics metrics, sampling, compatibility, findings, ranges, saved views, or chart behavior changes.
validation: Verify Portfolio contains no chart and Analytics is reachable from primary navigation and the Portfolio text link.

surfaces.condition: The native CLI binary, command syntax, JSON schema, or prerequisite resolution changes.
Agent-visible commands, documentation and skill relationships, freshness semantics, authorization boundaries, or routing behavior changes.
validation: Validate every documented command against pnpm cli help.
Verify refresh-batch documents its parallel scan, serialized merge, and conflict-retry boundary.
Verify relative context links resolve inside the repository.
Run a scoped Quality Runner fleet audit and inspect agent_usability.

surfaces.owner: Pronto repository maintainers and Codex skill routing
surfaces.condition: The Pronto CLI command surface or its agent operating boundary changes.
validation: Verify the skill documents refresh-batch parallel scan, serialized merge, and conflict retry semantics.
Run pnpm cli help and confirm the documented command is exposed.

surfaces.condition: Product boundaries, architecture, remediation order, quality gates, release behavior, or operator workflow changes.
validation: Review docs against .agents/context/commands.md and package.json scripts.

surfaces.condition: The desired remediation state, product truth, progress, blocker, drift, or continuity evidence changes.
A repository is newly registered while a fleet AI Showcase contract exists, or the Showcase goal, eligibility, readiness, or publication projection changes.
validation: Newly discovered repositories enter the normal registered fleet during the registry merge.
Registration and refresh do not mutate the Showcase contract or create placeholder rows; Showcase additions require an immediate explicit review with complete contract fields.
pnpm cli summary --json and verify the new repository is in the normal fleet while an unreviewed Showcase gap remains unranked and unknown.

surfaces.condition: Fallback, degradation, evidence normalization, or negative-path behavior changes.
validation: Run Quality Runner verify-gates with --only-gate failure_visibility in disposable mode and inspect evidence_state.

surfaces.owner: Codex runtime fork and Pronto provider adapter
surfaces.condition: Codex skill event identity, persistence, status semantics, retention, or Pronto aggregation changes.
validation: Run the Codex explicit and implicit skill integration tests.

surfaces.owner: Codex OTLP metrics exporter and Pronto localhost collector
surfaces.condition: Codex skill metric name, dimensions, temporality, OTLP JSON shape, collector lifecycle, coverage semantics, or source precedence changes.
validation: Run scoped skill_usage_collector and Skills fallback tests.
Start a fresh Codex process and verify an observed metric through pnpm cli skills --json.

surfaces.condition: Quality Runner changes its maturity feed, holistic pillar model, repository identity, gate, finding, maturity dimension, applicability, evidence coverage, critical cap, agent-usability, growth-health, freshness, or provenance contract.
validation: Confirm Project Compass and product-readiness values remain separate from repository maturity.

surfaces.path: src-tauri/src/core.rs, src-tauri/src/quality.rs, Quality Runner fleet detector publication, repository-local QR runs, and Pronto quality import
surfaces.owner: Pronto and Quality Runner integration owners
surfaces.condition: Fleet detector command, producer schema, exact-target publication, per-repository status, or findings coverage behavior changes.
validation: lifecycle-aware detector coverage regression excludes exact QR unsupported paths while retaining tracked totals
fleet detector sibling-artifact regression selects inspect findings while retaining latest verify gate evidence and rejects unmarked similarly named runs
Run a source QR detector refresh against a disposable fixture and verify Pronto refreshes target refs, imports exact-target findings, and rejects any published result that is not selected.

surfaces.owner: Quality Runner and the target repository
surfaces.condition: Web applicability, evidence levels, target identity, categorical readiness, route evidence, or release consumption changes.

surfaces.path: ~/.quality-runner/fleet-audit/current/mac-control-ideal-state.json, src-tauri/src/mac_control_maturity.rs, and the Quality Gates renderer
surfaces.owner: Quality Runner, Mac Control, and Pronto integration owners
surfaces.condition: Mac Control manifest schema, semantic evidence, source-grounding, provider-boundary, score, freshness, or user-facing disposition changes.
validation: Read back a Quality Runner v4 companion feed in Pronto.

surfaces.owner: GitHub provider adapter and repository maintainers
surfaces.condition: Remote identity, branch, pull request, release, or check-run evidence changes.
The build/promotion command contract, Tauri configuration, bundled assets, native entry points, or production installation behavior changes.
validation: Verify an unchanged loaded LaunchAgent uses kickstart without bootout or bootstrap, while missing and materially changed plists take the explicit registration path.
Validate .pronto/behavior-assurance.json and retain the background-service-lifecycle scenario in the owning Quality Runner evidence flow.

surfaces.condition: Papercuts capture, privacy, spool, health, or recovery behavior changes.
validation: Verify the hook and standalone CLI publish the same pronto-papercuts-observation/v1 contract.
Exercise an incompatible spooled record followed by a valid record and verify only the incompatible record is quarantined.
Verify timeout and nonzero-exit diagnostics expose sanitized cause, retry metadata, and a recovery command in health JSON and the Papercuts UI.
Exercise a denied-primary capture followed by a permitted flush.
